title: Joiarib
summary: (whom Jehovah defends) = Jehoiarib. (1.) The founder of one of the courses of the priests (Neh. 11:10).

inlines.v: (whom Jehovah defends) = Jehoiarib. (1.) The founder of one of the courses of the priests (Neh. 11:10).
(4.) Ezra 8:16, a "man of understanding" whom Ezra sent to "bring ministers for the house of God."
